desc:
THIS IS THE COOLEST DODGEBALL GAME 4V4, RANKED 1V1-4V4 AND MORE!!🔴

Unlock new abilities and control the court 
Unlock cool kill effects, emotes, titles and items🧐

[ CONTROLS ]

[ COMBAT ]
[M1] Hold — Charge / Throw Ball
[SPACE + Hold — M1] — Slow Fall While Charging
[E] Hold — Curve Ball
[G] — Use Ability

[ MOVEMENT ]
[Q] — Dash
[C] — Slide

[MISC]
Shift Lock: LEFT ALT | Emotes: B

🎮 CONTROLLER (Xbox / PlayStation)
Move: Left Stick | Camera: Right Stick
Jump: A / ✕
Throw: hold RT / R2, release to throw
Curve: hold LT / L2 while charging
Dash: RB / R1
Slide: LB / L1 (while running)
Sprint: push the stick all the way (or click LS / L3)
Use Ability: Y / △
Style Skill: click RS / R3
Shift Lock: D-Pad Left
Emotes: D-Pad Right
Leaderboard: D-Pad Up
Interact: X / □
Menus: A / ✕ select, B / ○ back
Prefer face buttons? Settings > Controller > Button Layout: Classic (Dash X / □, Slide B / ○)
